import re

# Parse the excel data into rows
lines = excel_data.strip().split('\n')

# Build header and confirmed rows
header_line = "Order ID\tCustomer\tDate\tStatus\tItems\tTotal Paid"
confirmed_lines = [header_line]

for line in lines:
    # Skip the header row and empty lines
    if not line.strip() or 'Order ID' in line or '(.venv)' in line or 'OBSERVATION' in line:
        continue
    # Check if this row has "confirmed" status
    if 'confirmed' in line.lower():
        # Extract the values from the (row, col): value format
        cells = re.findall(r'\(\d+, \d+\): ([^\t]+)', line)
        if len(cells) >= 6:
            confirmed_lines.append('\t'.join(c.strip() for c in cells))

confirmed_text = '\n'.join(confirmed_lines)
print(f"Found {len(confirmed_lines) - 1} confirmed orders")
print("Preview (first 5 rows):")
for row in confirmed_lines[:6]:
    print(row)
